MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition+contamination. Coating tasks use QT. Height and texture are shared across both pools. No wall_access modifier for ceilings.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.00) x smoke(1.50) x H4(2.00) x heavy_texture(1.25) = 7.50x
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.resolution: STACKING PARTITION — prep pool and coating pool never overlap. Extreme combos flagged for estimator review.

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x contamination x height x texture)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x height x texture)

MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.ceiling_vs_wall_note: No wall_access modifier for ceilings — access obstruction is irrelevant when working overhead. Furniture stays in place (drip-covered), not center-piled.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup (Full Room — Always)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC ceiling prime TSK_CEIL_FLOOR_PROTECT_SETUP (400 SF/hr). Full room floor protection — ALWAYS full for ceiling work (overhead drip zone). Rosin paper or plastic with taped seams. Same task regardless of NC or RP context.

task_production_rates.name: Cover Furniture with Poly Sheeting (In-Place)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ADAPTED from wall RP TSK_WLRP_FURNITURE_COVER (8 min/room). Ceiling RP covers furniture in-place (no center-pile) — drape poly sheeting over contents for overhead drip protection. Same time as wall furniture cover — technique is identical.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Wall Top at Ceiling Line (Spray Methods)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC ceiling prime TSK_CEIL_MASK_ADJACENT (130 LF/hr). Apply tape and paper to wall tops for ceiling spray masking. ~13% slower than wall masking (150 LF/hr) — working at ceiling line is overhead reach.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Ceiling Fixtures (Lights, Fans, Smoke Detectors)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from NC ceiling finish TSK_PROTECT_CEILING_FIXTURES (4 rooms/hr, ~15 min per room). Stuff and tape ~8 items per room (6 recessed lights + 2 ceiling boxes average). Same task regardless of NC or RP context.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Lightweight Opening Covers (Spray Methods)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ADAPTED from NC ceiling finish TSK_VERIFY_MASK_OPENINGS pattern (~3 min per opening, ~2 openings per room). Lightweight plastic over door and window openings to contain ceiling overspray. Per-room fixed time.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Scan — All Ceilings

QT2.notes: Quick visual scan overhead, major issues only

QT3.notes: Standard visual with raking work light, document all visible defects

QT4.notes: Systematic scan with raking light, photograph all defect areas

QT5.notes: Critical assessment, multiple passes, raking light, full photo documentation

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ADAPTED from wall RP TSK_WLRP_ASSESS_CONDITION (8-25 min). Ceiling assessment adds ~20% time for overhead viewing angle: brighter work light needed, neck fatigue, deliberate scanning. QT2: 10 min (wall=8), QT3: 18 min (wall=15), QT4: 24 min (wall=20), QT5: 30 min (wall=25).

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Test)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ADAPTED from wall RP TSK_WLRP_ASSESS_ADHESION (8 min). Overhead access requires step ladder for precise test placement — adds ~25%. 10 min/room. ASTM D3359 cross-hatch tape test at 2+ locations per room.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Meter Evaluation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ADAPTED from wall RP TSK_WLRP_ASSESS_MOISTURE (5 min). Overhead access adds ~20%. Moisture sources for ceilings: roof leaks, condensation, plumbing above. Active moisture is STOP WORK condition.

task_production_rates.name: Coating Identification — Latex vs Oil
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: ADAPTED from wall RP TSK_WLRP_ASSESS_COATING_ID (5 min). Overhead access adds ~20%. Solvent test with mineral spirits. Critical for primer compatibility — latex over oil requires adhesion primer.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Test (XRF or Swab)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED RRP module task. DIRECT transfer from wall RP TSK_RRP_LEAD_TEST (10 min). XRF or swab at 2+ ceiling locations per room. Identical rate — hand-held instrument, same technique regardless of surface orientation.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED RRP module task. DIRECT transfer from wall RP TSK_RRP_CONTAINMENT_SETUP (30 min). EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. Poly sheeting, warning signs, restrict access. Same rate — containment is room-level, not surface-specific.

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED RRP module task. DIRECT transfer from wall RP TSK_RRP_HEPA_VACUUM (20 min). HEPA vacuum all surfaces after each sanding/scraping disturbance. Required by EPA RRP Rule.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Containment Removal and Visual Clearance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED RRP module task. DIRECT transfer from wall RP TSK_RRP_CONTAINMENT_REMOVAL (20 min). Remove containment poly, visual clearance inspection.

task_production_rates.name: Lead-Contaminated Waste Disposal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: SHARED RRP module task. DIRECT transfer from wall RP TSK_RRP_WASTE_DISPOSAL (30 min). Package and dispose lead-contaminated debris per EPA RRP Rule. Per-job fixed time.

factor_modifier_definitions.description: GOOD condition — sound paint, minimal prep needed
FAIR condition — localized peeling, scattered damage, moderate prep
POOR condition — extensive peeling, heavy damage, full prep needed
No contamination — baseline
Mildew contamination — biocide treatment adds time
Smoke damage — extensive TSP wash, shellac stain-blocker adds significant time
Water stain — moderate additional prep and stain-blocking primer
Grease contamination — TSP cuts grease quickly, minimal additional time
QT2 economy — reduced prep intensity, basic coverage. Per Modifier_Registry.
QT3 standard — baseline for all rates
QT4 premium — thorough prep, careful application, crisp edges
QT5 fine finish — multiple light coats, thorough inspection
Standard ceiling height 8-9ft — work from floor with extension pole
Tall 10-12ft — step ladder may be needed, longer extension pole, more fatigue
Vaulted 13-17ft — scaffold or baker staging required, significant overhead access challenge
Cathedral 18ft+ — scaffold or lift required, extreme overhead work, production rate cuts in half
Smooth ceiling — baseline
Orange peel texture — +10% surface area, 10% slower application
Knockdown texture — +15% surface area, 15% slower
Heavy texture (stomp, skip trowel) — +25% surface area, 25% slower

prep_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x contamination x height x texture)
prep_pool.max_theoretical: POOR(2.0) x smoke(1.5) x H4(2.0) x heavy_texture(1.25) = 7.50x
prep_pool.ceiling_vs_wall_note: No wall_access modifier for ceilings. Max theoretical is 7.50x vs wall RP's 9.75x.

coating_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x height x texture)
coating_pool.ceiling_vs_wall_note: No wall_access modifier for ceilings. Max theoretical is 3.75x vs wall RP's 4.88x.

round_configurations.name: Full Ceiling Repaint — Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Standard full ceiling repaint for FAIR/POOR condition. Interstage after primer and after finish coat 1.

round_configurations.name: Economy Ceiling Repaint — Prime + 1 Finish Coat
Cosmetic Ceiling Refresh — No Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.notes: Most common residential ceiling repaint. Sound paint, degloss + 2 finish coats. Primer skipped when adhesion test passes.

round_configurations.name: Economy Ceiling Refresh — No Prime + 1 Finish Coat
round_configurations.notes: Fastest execution path. QT2, GOOD condition, single coat. Rental turnover scenario.

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll on ceilings, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Ceiling primer: spray at 275 SF/hr, backroll at 325 SF/hr — spray is bottleneck. Ceiling finish R1: spray at 275 SF/hr, backroll at 275 SF/hr — matched. Ceiling finish R2: spray at 300 SF/hr, backroll at 300 SF/hr — matched.
coupling_constraints.notes: Spray and backroll done by 2-person crew working in tandem overhead. Backroller is the bottleneck on ceilings due to overhead fatigue. All spray rates verified <= backroll rates.

crew_configurations.name: Single Ceiling Roller
crew_configurations.notes: One person does ceiling cut-in and rolling with extension pole. Most common for RP (occupied home, room-by-room).

crew_configurations.name: Ceiling Roller Pair
crew_configurations.notes: Cutter stays ahead of roller for larger ceiling areas.

crew_configurations.name: Ceiling Spray + Backroll Crew
crew_configurations.notes: Sprayer and backroller work in tandem overhead. Backroller sets pace. More fatiguing than wall spray+backroll.

crew_configurations.name: Single Ceiling Sprayer
crew_configurations.notes: Spray-only ceiling application, one person. Less common — backroll preferred for ceilings.

critical_constraints.no_spray_only_primer: Spray-only (no backroll) is NEVER valid for primer on previously painted ceiling surfaces. Backroll is MANDATORY for adhesion.
critical_constraints.always_full_floor_protection: Floor protection is ALWAYS full-room for ceiling work. No perimeter-only option — overhead drip zone covers entire floor.
critical_constraints.furniture_stays_in_place: Ceiling RP does NOT move furniture. Furniture stays in place, covered with poly for overhead drip protection. No center-pile.
critical_constraints.no_wall_access_modifier: No wall_access modifier for ceilings. Access obstruction is irrelevant when working overhead. Furniture is drip-covered in place.
critical_constraints.shellac_cleanup_warning: SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT (shellac) requires denatured alcohol for tool cleanup. Water does not work.
critical_constraints.spot_prime_always: Spot prime all spackled/scraped areas regardless of whether full primer coat is applied. Prevents flashing.
critical_constraints.overhead_penalty_already_applied: All rates already include 15-20% overhead penalty vs wall equivalents. Do NOT apply additional ceiling factor.
